Time of start of mechanical chest compression device application in the ED

Start time is defined as the moment the MCCD is deployed (e.g., if the backboard of the LUCAS device is placed under the patient during one pause, and the top part of the LUCAS device is placed during a second pause, the start time should be when the backboard was placed). 

If the LUCAS device backboard was already placed on the stretcher prior to the patient's arrival, the start time should be the time when the LUCAS device is latched on one side.

Time of end of mechanical chest compression device application in the ED

End time is defined as the moment when all adjustments are done and the MCCD is performing chest compressions properly, or the moment the placement was abandoned completely.  If the MCCD is deployed but chest compressions are not being performed properly and the team adjusts the MCCD, record the time AFTER further adjustments are made and appropriate chest compressions start.
